talos:cluster/cluster:Cluster.description: Manages a Talos cluster: bootstraps etcd and tracks Kubernetes version. This resource completes once the Talos layer (etcd, apid, kubelet) is healthy across all control plane nodes. It does not wait for Kubernetes components to be ready — use talos.cluster.getHealth for that before depending on the Kubernetes API.

clientConfiguration.description: The Talos client configuration. Use clientConfigurationWo when using ephemeral resources.

clientConfigurationWo.description: **NOTE:** This field is write-only and its value will not be updated in state as part of read operations. Write-only variant of clientConfiguration for use with ephemeral resources. Requires Terraform 1.11+.

controlPlaneNodes.description: List of all control plane node IPs used for etcd health checks. Defaults to [node]. Required for HA clusters where all control plane IPs must be listed.

endpoint.description: The endpoint to use when connecting to the node. Defaults to node.

kubernetesVersion.description: Desired Kubernetes version (e.g. `v1.32.0`). This is the canonical driver for Kubernetes upgrades: changing it runs Talos's `upgrade-k8s` procedure, which sequentially upgrades kube-apiserver, kube-controller-manager, kube-scheduler, kube-proxy, and kubelet on each node with health gating. Set `ignoreKubernetesUpgradeDrift = true` on `talos.machine.Machine` so that image tag changes owned by `upgrade-k8s` are excluded from drift detection and `talos.cluster.Cluster` fully owns the upgrade sequencing.

node.description: The IP address of the control plane node to bootstrap etcd on. Must be an IP: it defaults into `controlPlaneNodes`, which the health checks compare against the addresses Kubernetes reports. Use `endpoint` to connect through a hostname.

inputs.description: A collection of arguments for invoking getConfiguration.

clusterEndpoint.description: The endpoint of the talos kubernetes cluster

clusterName.description: The name of the talos kubernetes cluster

configPatches.description: The list of config patches to apply to the generated configuration

docs.description: Whether to generate documentation for the generated configuration. Defaults to false

examples.description: Whether to generate examples for the generated configuration. Defaults to false

kubernetesVersion.description: Kubernetes version baked into the generated configuration. Used at bootstrap for new nodes. To upgrade Kubernetes on a running cluster, use `talos_cluster.kubernetes_version`. Without `ignoreKubernetesUpgradeDrift = true` on `talos.machine.Machine`, bumping this value causes `talos.machine.Machine` to re-apply the five Kubernetes component image fields directly, bypassing `upgrade-k8s`'s sequencing. With the flag set, only `talos_cluster.kubernetes_version` drives the upgrade. Keep this in sync with `talos_cluster.kubernetes_version`.

machineType.description: The type of machine to generate the configuration for

talosVersion.description: The Talos version contract used to generate the machine configuration. This does not control the installed Talos version — use `configPatches` to set `machine.install.image` for that. Keep this pinned to the version used when the cluster was created; it is independent of `talos_machine.image`, and regular Talos upgrades do not require bumping it. Only change it when you deliberately want a newer contract's schema and defaults, which regenerates the machine configuration on its own. See [Reproducible Machine Configuration](https://docs.siderolabs.com/talos/latest/configure-your-talos-cluster/system-configuration/reproducible-machine-configuration) for details. Example values: `v1.12`, `v1.12.1`, `1.12`, `1.12.1`
